entries.confirmed: SKILL.md requires name (1-64 chars, lowercase a-z 0-9 and hyphens, no leading/trailing/double hyphen, must match parent directory) and description (1-1024 chars). Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines; validate with skills-ref.

AGENTS.md is plain Markdown with no mandatory structure; the nearest file in the directory tree takes precedence; suggested contents are project overview, build and test commands, code style, testing, security.
